samples.response: En metallsked känns kallare än en träsked i samma rum, även om de har samma temperatur. Trä däremot är en dålig värmeledare, så den håller värmen från din hand längre. Därför känns metallskeden kallare, även om den har samma temperatur som träskeden.

limitations: Version 0.2 is an author-reviewed public pilot, not a population-valid national benchmark.
The small sample sizes produce wide uncertainty intervals and are intended for harness validation and early model profiling.
Open-generation scores depend on the selected judge and should be calibrated against native-speaker human ratings.
The pilot is text-only and does not yet measure speech, vision or interactive multi-step agents.
The compact long-context item is a revision-tracking smoke test, not evidence of 128k-context capability.
The bundled suite is public and may be present in model training data.
The target is an experimental SFT-only checkpoint trained mostly on English Dolci-Instruct data, without preference tuning or reinforcement learning.
The target ran from the pinned public BF16 Transformers checkpoint on Apple MPS with the checkpoint chat template's required empty thinking prefix; target reasoning was disabled.

The 31.3B local Gemma Q4_K_M judge ran with reasoning disabled after target generation from preserved responses and has not yet been calibrated against native-speaker Swedish ratings, so judged scores are provisional.
SVEA uses short prompts and does not evaluate this checkpoint's 256K-context capability.
Results may differ with other dtypes, quantizations, inference runtimes or chat templates.
